title: New Ctrl+Shift+8 default Zoomit: Snip - "Scrolling Screenshot" intercepts and breaks popular MS Office key combo

judgment.rationale: The shortcut and affected applications are explicit, and the current registration is global; the preferred default and migration policy are not yet established.
evidence: The reporter says ZoomIt's default Ctrl+Shift+8 scrolling-screenshot shortcut intercepts the formatting-mark shortcut in Word and classic Outlook on 0.99.1.
They also ask for clearer indication of which utility activated when the screen dims.
ZoomIt registers configured snip and panorama keys as system hotkeys in https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/ZoomIt/ZoomIt/Zoomit.cpp.

fix_assessment.rationale: The shortcut and affected applications are explicit, and the current registration is global; the preferred default and migration policy are not yet established.

proposed_fixes.title: Resolve the ZoomIt and Office shortcut collision
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The global hotkey can conflict with application shortcuts; changing its default or adding contextual behavior needs compatibility and product review.
plan: Reproduce the default shortcut in Word or classic Outlook and compare after changing the ZoomIt binding.
Evaluate a less conflicting default or discoverable conflict guidance without silently overwriting customized shortcuts.
If approved, implement the chosen policy and separately assess an accessible indication of the active capture tool.
verification: Office's formatting shortcut remains usable with the chosen configuration, and ZoomIt capture remains discoverable and works with its configured binding.

reproduce.title: Compare ZoomIt and Office shortcuts
setup: Enable ZoomIt using its default scrolling screenshot shortcut.
steps: Focus a document or message and press Ctrl+Shift+8.
Change the ZoomIt shortcut and repeat.
reproduce.expected_result: The user can toggle formatting marks without an unexpected capture and can still invoke ZoomIt using its configured shortcut.
